Google made Gemini 4 Argon generally available on October 13, 2026. I couldn't open Google's post directly, so the details below come from secondary coverage that quotes or links it.

**The Google post:** Google's announcement is titled "Gemini 4 Argon is now available for everyone," and it's on blog.google under the gemini-models section. A Japanese report linked to the same post and to a separate Google safety and security post about Gemini 4.

**Who can use it:** Per the GA post as quoted by one source, Argon is "globally available today for developers and enterprises via the API in AI Studio and Gemini platform, for Google AI Ultra subscribers in Google Antigravity, and Google AI Ultra and Pro subscribers in the Gemini app and AI Mode in Search." A separate Google post on Gemini app availability says Argon is now available in the Gemini app, delivering frontier reasoning and improved performance across complex tasks.

**API details:** The model ID is gemini-4-argon. Google's GA post prices the public API at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens through 30 Nov 2026, then $4 and $20. Google documents a combined input-output context limit of up to 1,048,576 tokens.

**Background:** This wasn't the first announcement. The company had first unveiled Argon to a limited group of cybersecurity partners on September 30, so the October update broadens availability rather than marking the model's first announcement.

**Caveats:** Performance claims are vendor-reported. One source notes that there is no independent verification yet, because third parties can only measure it from today. For the authoritative wording on pricing, limits, and eligibility, check the Google post itself.

Links: [{"title":"Meta Muse Wonder: o que é, quanto custa e qual versão você recebe","url":"https://www.eesel.ai/pt/blog/meta-muse-wonder"},{"title":"Muse Wonder puts Meta back in the AI race with frontier models","url":"https://yourstory.com/ai-story/muse-wonder-meta-ai-race-frontier-models"},{"title":"Meta Releases Muse Wonder AI Model, Stock Rises Over 3%","url":"https://pro.stockalarm.io/news/meta-releases-muse-wonder-ai-model-stock-rises-over-3-dc4315e6"},{"title":"Meta Muse Wonder: qué es, cuánto cuesta y qué versión obtienes","url":"https://www.eesel.ai/es/blog/meta-muse-wonder"},{"title":"Meta Unveils Muse Wonder as Multibillion-Dollar AI Overhaul Faces a Key Test","url":"https://www.citybiz.co/?p=917227"},{"title":"meta lanza muse wonder sus modelos de ia mas potentes hasta ahora","url":"https://es.euronews.com/2026/10/13/meta-lanza-muse-wonder-sus-modelos-de-ia-mas-potentes-hasta-ahora"},{"title":"2610 meta launches muse wonder series to rival anthropic openai models","url":"https://www.businessinsider.jp/article/2610-meta-launches-muse-wonder-series-to-rival-anthropic-openai-models/"},{"title":"Meta Muse Wonder : ce que c'est, combien ça coûte et quelle version vous obtenez","url":"https://www.eesel.ai/fr/blog/meta-muse-wonder"},{"title":"meta muse wonder","url":"https://www.orcarouter.ai/vi/blog/meta-muse-wonder"}]

Meta launched Muse Wonder on October 12, 2026, as its most capable model line so far. Two versions shipped together: a standard API model and a Full checkpoint.

- **Release and positioning:** Released by its Superintelligence Lab on October 12, 2026, the models are designed to handle demanding personal and professional tasks. Meta presents them as aimed at harder work, involving coding, planning, research and document understanding.
- **Competitive framing:** Meta is positioning the models against top rivals. The company says the model can compete with leading systems from OpenAI and Anthropic after an expensive overhaul of its AI business.
- **Claimed strengths:** Meta says Muse Wonder offers substantial improvements over its earlier models, particularly in coding and answering financial and legal questions. Those claims are not yet verified. Those performance claims remain subject to independent testing.
- **Two versions:** According to a third-party blog (OrcaRouter), Meta's model page lists muse-wonder-1.0 as the ID served on the Meta Model API and through Muse Code, Meta's terminal coding agent. The Full ID is described by Meta as available only to Muse Code subscribers, rather than being a flag on the API model.
- **Memory and focus features:** Meta highlights two capabilities. Active Memory is Meta's name for carrying context about the user across conversations and bringing back the right detail when it matters. Active Focus covers persisting through to the end: trying another approach after a blocker, asking for clarification, and confirming before important actions.
- **Benchmarks:** On Meta's MemoryBench, one blog reports 85.6 for Wonder versus 85.5 for Full and 81.5 for Opus 5.5. A separate post says the API version scores 52 on the Artificial Analysis Index versus 58 for Claude Opus 5.5 at the same price. These figures conflict with Meta's broader claims, so treat them cautiously.
- **Market reaction:** Meta shares rose as much as 4.7% on Monday.

Note that several sources are vendor or marketing blogs (eesel.ai, OrcaRouter), and the benchmark numbers come from those secondary write-ups rather than Meta's own documentation. For primary details, check Meta's official announcement or model documentation directly.

content.text:
Here are the three biggest AI model releases from October 11–18, 2026:

1. **Meta Muse Wonder 1.0 (Oct 12):** Meta's Superintelligence Lab released Muse Wonder 1.0 and a higher-end Muse Wonder Full, its most capable closed models so far, which it pitches as rivals to OpenAI and Anthropic for coding, planning, research and long-term memory. [Source: Euronews](https://es.euronews.com/2026/10/13/meta-lanza-muse-wonder-sus-modelos-de-ia-mas-potentes-hasta-ahora)

2. **Google Gemini 4 Argon goes public (Oct 13):** Google opened Gemini 4 Argon, its newest top model, to everyone through the API, AI Studio, the Gemini app and AI Mode in Search, at an introductory $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens. [Source: Google blog](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/products/gemini-app/gemini-4-availability)

3. **Meta Muse Spark Open (Oct 15):** Meta released Muse Spark Open, which it calls the most capable US open-weight model to date; the weights are free to download, it's offered through providers like Together AI, Groq and OpenRouter, and it can run locally on two Mac Studios. [Source: Meta research blog](https://research.meta.ai/blog/muse-spark-open)

- **Gemini 4 Argon wasn't new:** Google first announced it on September 30 for a small group of cyber-defense partners. What happened this week is that everyone got access.
- **Benchmarks are unverified:** The performance claims come from the companies themselves and haven't been independently tested yet.
- **Close runners-up:** NVIDIA's open-weight Nemotron 3.5 models (Oct 15) and xAI's Grok Voice 3.0 (Oct 14).

- [Meta – Introducing Muse Spark Open](https://research.meta.ai/blog/muse-spark-open)
